description: The same event as Matthew, Mark, Luke and John each tell it: the parallels that cover a passage, with every Gospel's passage side by side and, if asked, each text in turn. Called with no reference, it lists all the parallels by section.

edition.description: Edition to quote the verses from: osnb (Norwegian Bokmål), osnn (Norwegian Nynorsk), osen (English), oses (Spanish), sblgnt (Greek New Testament), tanach (Hebrew Old Testament), kjv (King James Version, English), web (World English Bible), bsb (Berean Standard Bible, English), asv (American Standard Version, English), luther_1912 (Luther 1912, German), segond_1910 (Louis Segond 1910, French), rv_1909 (Reina-Valera 1909, Spanish), akjv (American King James Version, English), albanian (Albanian Bible), bungo (Bungo-yaku, classical Japanese), cadman (Cadman 1926, Vietnamese), chinese_union_simp (Chinese Union Version, simplified), chinese_union_trad (Chinese Union Version, traditional), cpdv (Catholic Public Domain Version, English), dbt (Darby Translation, English), diodati (Diodati, Italian), drb (Douay-Rheims (Challoner), English), elberfelder_1905 (Elberfelder 1905, German), elberfelder_1871 (Elberfelder 1871, German), dnb30 (Bibelselskapet 1930, Norwegian Bokmål), erv (English Revised Version), finn (Finnish 1776), geneva (Geneva Bible, English), hcv (Haitian Creole Bible (1985)), he_modern (Modern Hebrew Bible (Delitzsch NT)), jps (JPS Tanakh 1917, English), kougo (Kougo-yaku 1954/55, Japanese), lv_gluck_8 (Glück Bible, Latvian), martin (Martin 1744, French), opt (Old Persian Version, Persian), rv_1858 (Reina-Valera 1858 New Testament, Spanish), sagradas (Sagradas Escrituras 1569, Spanish), slt (Smith's Literal Translation, English), swahili (Swahili New Testament), synodal (Synodal Translation 1876, Russian), tagab (Ang Biblia 1905, Tagalog), wbt (Webster Bible 1833, English). Default: the edition for `language`.

include_text.description: true quotes each Gospel's text of the parallels found, one after the other (at most 200 verses in all); false gives the passages only. Default: false.

language.description: Language for names, notes and study content, and for the links to bible.flogvit.com: en (English), nb (Norwegian Bokmål), nn (Norwegian Nynorsk), sv (Swedish), fr (French), es (Spanish), fi (Finnish), de (German). Content missing in a language falls back to English. Default: en.

mapping.description: Verse numbering to read the reference in and to number the answer in: a mapping id from list_verse_mappings, e.g. "english_kj" (King James), "dnb2024_nb" (Bibelselskapet 2024), or a short name such as "kjv" or "dnb2024". Numberings differ where a psalm heading is a verse or not, and at chapter breaks: Malachi 4:5 in the King James numbering is Malachi 3:23 in osnb. Default: osnb, the site's own numbering, which follows the Hebrew and Greek.

reference.description: A passage in Matthew, Mark, Luke or John, e.g. "Mark 4:35-41", "Luke 15", "Joh 6,1-15"; gives the parallels that cover it. Default: none, which lists them all.

name: get_gospel_parallels
title: Gospel parallels
